base_family: R18 DEV-frozen zero-intercept Ridge alpha1000 mean plus first3 Fourier harmonics; no refit and no new model downloads.
motivation: R18 native7 residual improved curve/daily but had bias and peak tradeoffs. This new registered exploration tests sum-neutral forecasts and prior daily-max preservation. Same month has been repeatedly examined; no independent confirmation.
projection: Closest additive-shift box projection preserves prior sum of normalized predictions per global/cell/PDU group over each7day window; optional caps and pins preserve each unmasked prior daily max. These are forecast consistency constraints, not physical energy conservation. No future truth or future validity mask used.
family_selection: First DEV origin14 fixed.25. Prefer nonprior with primary WAPE/daily within+.001pp, RMSE/P95<=1.005prior, peak<=1.02prior, abs_bias<=prior+.01pp and a5<=prior+.01pp. Choose most metric-best-control leads then minimum equally normalized primary loss. If none use minimum-loss diagnostic.
weight_selection: Same single family on DEV origin15 and aggregate14/15, strengths0/.1/.25/.5/1. Apply all guards at both origins; aggregate at least3 descriptive bests and at least one primary improvement .001pp. Among eligible maximize leads and minimize primary; smaller weight within paired-date1SE among same-leading-count choices. Otherwise0. Overlapping DEV dates are stability evidence only.
criterion_change: Focus changed prospectively from R18 requirement to retain baseline lead count to the user objective multiple metric bests with explicit bias/a5 guards. R18 frozen selection remains unchanged.
diagnostic: One nonprior family and strength frozen before TEST; diagnostic strength is chosen positive strength else.25. No TEST rank reselection.
